lords.theme: Lord's, London, on a sunny Test match day, laid out like the real ground
lords.far: PAVILION END at the top: the grand red-brick Victorian Pavilion with its two turrets topped by small domes, tall arched windows and long white-railed balconies packed with members in red-and-yellow striped ties, under a blue sky
lords.sides: LEFT SIDE: the Mound Stand with its row of white peaked tent canopies. RIGHT SIDE: the tall modern white Grand Stand with a plain roof. Both packed with fans to the picture edges
lords.near: NURSERY END at the bottom of the picture: the white curved futuristic Media Centre pod (like a big white spaceship with a long glass window strip), raised on stilts high above the near stand, its top cut off by the bottom edge, with fans in front of it
lords.crowd: chunky members and fans in red-and-yellow striped ties, blazers, straw boaters and panama hats

oval.theme: The Kia Oval, south London, on a sunny afternoon, laid out like the real ground
oval.far: PAVILION END at the top: the red-brick Victorian pavilion with a white clock and balconies, and rising right behind it the huge round open iron frame of a Victorian gasholder, under a blue sky
oval.sides: LEFT and RIGHT SIDES: modern white stands with chocolate-brown seats and tiers of fans, red-brick London terraced houses peeking over the top corners
oval.near: VAUXHALL END at the bottom of the picture: the front of a huge modern four-tier white stand with glass boxes and a curved white roof edge, its top cut off by the bottom edge, packed with fans in front
oval.crowd: chunky Surrey fans in chocolate-brown caps and brown-and-white scarves

headingley.theme: Headingley, Leeds, on a bright day, laid out like the real ground
headingley.far: FOOTBALL STAND END at the top: the big modern stand with a white cantilever roof and white-rose banners on blue, and beyond it green Yorkshire hills with stone terraced houses and a church tower
headingley.sides: LEFT SIDE: the open Western Terrace, a lively mass of fans in fancy dress (bananas, superheroes, nuns). RIGHT SIDE: dark green seats in a low stand with Yorkshire stone walls
headingley.near: KIRKSTALL LANE END at the bottom of the picture: the front of the modern Emerald Stand with glass hospitality boxes and a sloping roof edge, its top cut off by the bottom edge, packed with fans in front
headingley.crowd: chunky Yorkshire fans in blue and flat caps, with lots of fancy-dress costumes

edgbaston.theme: Edgbaston, Birmingham, on a lively summer evening, laid out like the real ground
edgbaston.far: PAVILION END at the top: the sweeping modern pavilion with a big curved white wave roof, glass boxes and tiers of navy seats, with leafy trees behind and a golden evening sky
edgbaston.sides: LEFT and RIGHT SIDES: modern stands with navy and sky-blue seats packed with fans, giant inflatables bouncing over the crowd
edgbaston.near: CITY END at the bottom of the picture: the famous rowdy Hollies Stand, a huge steep tier of fans in wild fancy dress waving flags and inflatables, with Birmingham tower blocks just visible, cut off by the bottom edge
edgbaston.crowd: chunky Bears fans in navy and sky blue, many in cartoon bear costumes and fancy dress

oldtrafford.theme: Emirates Old Trafford, Manchester, on a showery bright day, laid out like the real ground
oldtrafford.far: PAVILION END at the top: the old red-brick Victorian pavilion with white balconies, and just to its right the striking modern red jagged-roofed Point building with a glass front, with a rainbow and fluffy clouds above
oldtrafford.sides: LEFT and RIGHT SIDES: modern stands with bright red seats packed with fans, umbrellas popping up, red-brick Manchester terraces and a mill chimney over the corners
oldtrafford.near: BRIAN STATHAM END at the bottom of the picture: the front of a tall modern hotel block with rows of glass windows overlooking the ground, its top cut off by the bottom edge, packed with fans in front
oldtrafford.crowd: chunky Lancashire fans in red rain macs and red-rose scarves, some with red umbrellas
oldtrafford.light: bright sun breaking through clouds from top-left

trentbridge.theme: Trent Bridge, Nottingham, on a sunny day, laid out like the real ground
trentbridge.far: PAVILION END at the top: the historic red-brick pavilion with a white clock gable and white balconies, and behind it a glimpse of the River Trent with swans and rowing boats and an old iron bridge
trentbridge.sides: LEFT SIDE: the Fox Road stand with green-and-gold seats. RIGHT SIDE: old red-brick stands with white railings and big leafy trees. Both packed with fans to the picture edges
trentbridge.near: RADCLIFFE ROAD END at the bottom of the picture: the front of the big red-brick and white-steel Radcliffe Road stand with a tall upper tier, its top cut off by the bottom edge, packed with fans in front
trentbridge.crowd: chunky Notts fans in green and gold, some in green feathered archer hats
trentbridge.ring: low dark forest-green boundary boards, much darker than the bright field
